reading.body:
TierPoint - Charlotte Data Center in Mecklenburg County, North Carolina, is operated by TierPoint, but no IT capacity in megawatts has been published for this facility.

Without a published capacity figure, the facility cannot be sized against other data centers in this collection, or judged for whether it could plausibly host AI training infrastructure, which typically requires tens of megawatts and up. What is on record is the facility's location and operator, not its scale.

TierPoint - Charlotte Data Center holds 6 published certifications: SOC 1 Type 2 (audited controls over financial reporting processes), PCI DSS (the standard required to handle payment card data), HIPAA (handling of protected health information), ISO 27001 (a certified information security management system), ITAR (a specific compliance or security standard), HITRUST (a healthcare-focused security framework built on top of HIPAA). Together these qualify the facility for regulated workloads spanning security auditing, payments, and healthcare data, though which specific tenants rely on which certification is not disclosed.

North Carolina has 6 facilities mapped in this site's dataset, of which 5 publish a megawatt figure, totaling 51.47 MW.
